title: Supply and Installation of ON Grid and OFF Grid Solar Inverter at various Lighthouses under Kolkata Directorate.
summary: Two-cover online tender for supplying and installing on-grid and off-grid solar inverters at various lighthouses under the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

scope.item: Supply and Installation of ON Grid and OFF Grid Solar Inverter at various Lighthouses under Kolkata Directorate

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. Tender fee 'Not Applicable'. EMD by DD/FDR from any commercial bank in favour of Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, or valid MSME/NSIC certificate; original EMD/hard copy of certificate to reach the office by 05.09.2024.

eligibility: Reputed firms with experience in similar works: supply of ON Grid/OFF Grid solar inverters in Central Govt./State Govt./PSU/Autonomous bodies/reputed private establishments
EMD exemption only for bidders with valid NSIC/MSME registration in the subject work

unreadable: Hindi text layer garbled (font mojibake); English portions read

notes: Section-1 NIT only; no BOQ, list of lighthouses, inverter quantities or ratings. NIT dated 14.08.2024; bid submission 15.08.2024 to 05.09.2024 15:00; pre-bid 23.08.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 06.09.2024 16:00. Bidders asked to visit site before quoting.
